sky_alpha._about: Alpha for 'sky' textures: sky = bright and unsaturated. Tested on both tree crops: clean silhouettes.
sky_alpha.formula: alpha = max(clamp((0.70 - lum) / 0.12, 0, 1), clamp((sat - 0.25) / 0.10, 0, 1) * (lum < 0.85)); lum = mean(rgb), sat = max(rgb) - min(rgb), rgb in [0,1]
